s1092: Which of these road signs shows the direction of travel on small-radius bends with limited visibility, and also the direction to take to go around road works?

s1135: Which of these road signs marks a road on which drivers have priority when passing through uncontrolled intersections?

Outside built-up areas sign 2.3 is placed in advance, 150−300 metres before the intersection, with plate 8.1.1 if sign 2.3 is placed before the intersection, or with plate 8.1.2 if sign 2.4 is placed before the intersection.

s1156: Which of these road signs prohibits the driver from continuing without stopping at the "Stop" line?
s1157: According to paragraph 2.4 of Chapter 2 (Priority signs) of Annex 1 to the Law of Georgia on Road Traffic, road sign 2.4 "Stop" prohibits the driver from continuing without stopping at the "Stop" line or, if there is none, at the edge of the carriageway being crossed. The driver must give way to drivers on the road being crossed, or, if plate 8.13 is present, to drivers on the main road. The sign is placed where vehicles on the crossing road cannot be seen well enough; it may also be placed before a railway crossing or a quarantine checkpoint (in this case the driver must stop before the "Stop" line or, if there is none, before the sign).

s1207: Only in accordance with the technical conditions for that specific type of dangerous goods
s1208: Only in accordance with the written instructions issued by the consignor

s1211: According to subparagraph "b" of paragraph 5 of Article 9 of the technical regulation "Rules for the Carriage of Goods by Motor Vehicles", approved by Order No. 1-1/1562 of the Minister of Economy and Sustainable Development of Georgia of 18 August 2011, when carrying dangerous goods, in addition to meeting the requirements set by paragraph 3 of Article 1 of these Rules, the driver must, in the event of a road traffic accident and/or an emergency, act in accordance with the rules for carrying that specific type of dangerous goods, the technical conditions and the written instructions issued by the consignor.
